Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (rerank pilot)

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment. High-level: Cartique wants a reranking layer to improve search relevance on product listing queries without touching your primary retrieval layer. Key success metrics called out were NDCG@10 and MRR for the top 5 results, and no regressions on zero-click/brand queries.

What we agreed on: 
- Redwood will run an initial fit evaluation on a 1k sample you provided (obfuscated) and return NDCG/MRR baselines plus recommended model variants.
- Cartique to provide a short-term evaluation slice (examples + relevance labels) and a lightweight privacy/PII constraints doc.
- If fit looks good, run a 2-week canary AB at 5-10% traffic (read-only scoring -> compare metrics) then expand.

Immediate asks for Cartique: 
1) Shared S3 or Drive path with the 1k sample (JSONL format) and relevance labels (0-3).
2) Any hard constraints around latency (p95 target), tokenization differences, or output filtering.
3) Who should sign the simple pilot SOW for a 60-day evaluation? (we can use the template we shared)

What Redwood will deliver next (by EOD Tuesday):
- A short synth evaluation (NDCG@10, MRR@5) across 3 candidate rerank models and a small prompt set.
- Quick checklist for canary AB and instrumentation (what to measure, dashboards).

Marissa will attach preliminary numbers from a quick local run and Rishi will sketch the canary AB measurement plan.

Thanks — Hannah

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery (rerank pilot)

Hi Julia — putting the quick eval results and model recommendations here (see attached CSV and prompt set). Ran three short experiments on the 1k sample (note: labels are noisy; this is a fit check, not a production claim).

Attached artifacts: cartique_sample_1000.jsonl (what you uploaded), ndcg_mrr_preview.csv (per-query metrics), eval_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (3 prompt templates we used).

Summary numbers (prelim):
- Baseline (current retrieval only, scoring with your current LTR signals): NDCG@10 = 0.420, MRR@5 = 0.370
- rw-re-rank-v1 (dense+LLM cross-encoder): NDCG@10 = 0.612, MRR@5 = 0.581
- rw-re-rank-v1-quant (int8 quantized variant): NDCG@10 = 0.588, MRR@5 = 0.552
- small LLM reranker (llama2-13b-finetune-lite): NDCG@10 = 0.565, MRR@5 = 0.530

Observations:
- The cross-encoder reranker gives a solid uplift vs baseline on this sample (median NDCG uplift +0.19).
- Quantized variant preserves most of the quality while cutting runtime by ~2.8x in our local bench. Good candidate if you have strict cost/latency constraints.
- Failure modes seen in the sample: a) brand-protect queries sometimes get demoted when the reranker over-weights matching synonyms, b) long tail product title queries can return paraphrase mismatches. We're flagging these for prompt set expansion and additional labeled examples.

Recommended immediate plan:
1) Short canary: 2-week AB at 5% traffic using rw-re-rank-v1-quant as the first test (lower cost, near parity with v1). Compare NDCG@10, MRR@5, and brand-protect pass-rate.
2) Instrument guard-rule checks: compute the % of brand queries that changed ranking; require pass-rate >= 99% for promotion.
3) If canary passes, expand to 25% and consider rw-re-rank-v1 for high-intent queries where latency budget allows.

I've uploaded the full per-query CSV and a short notebook to the Drive link Hannah included. If you want, we can run a targeted prompt/labeling round for the brand-protect set before canary start.

-Marissa

Subject: Fwd: Eval synthesis, model recommendations & A/B hypotheses (Cartique rerank pilot)

Forwarding final checklist and AB measurement plan (attached: canary-ab-checklist.pdf). Key points for how we'll run canary and what we need from Cartique procurement/infra: 
- Canary config: 5% traffic (randomized by session id), 14 days. Primary metrics: NDCG@10 (increase > 0.10 over baseline), MRR@5 (increase > 0.10), brand-protect pass-rate >= 99.0%. Secondary: latency p95 delta <= +60ms.
- Instrumentation: include per-query labels, pre/post ranks, reranker score, and guard-rule flag. Need a read-only scoring endpoint (no write-to-index) for the canary.
- Rollback triggers: any severe user-affecting drop (NDCG decrease > 0.05 over 24h) or brand-protect pass-rate < 98% triggers immediate rollback.
- Legal/procurement ask: we need a short pilot SOW and an NDA addendum for sample data if Cartique prefers. Hannah — can you loop in procurement/legal and push the SOW?

I'll set up a short dashboard template in Redwood Console and share the link once ready.

-Rishi
